decisions.reason: Encrypted secondary communication fits a German mid-sized B2B security software portfolio well and is likely to be retained while the firm builds adoption.
A mobile PDF signature function is commercially useful but can be folded into broader products, so it has some rationalization risk even though it should stay for now.
A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is highly aligned with enterprise cybersecurity demand and looks strategically core rather than disposable.
The secure email-to-app delivery robot appears more niche and feature-like than the core security stack, but it still complements the firm's communication security offering.
A QR-code-based hardware signature token is the most burdensome to support for a software-oriented firm, yet it remains plausible as part of a secure signing solution set.
A payment network security compliance suite serves regulated enterprise customers and is likely to be kept because compliance products usually have sticky B2B demand.
